titleEn: Sub-decree no.29 on reclassification and donation of state property

articles.en: The land parcel of 1.57 (one point five seven) hectares located at Muoy Village, Laminh Commune, Bor Kaeo District, Ratanakiri Province, belonging to the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, is hereby reclassified from public state land to private state land and removed from the state property inventory, in order to be transferred to Mr Heng Sokhen for possession, use and lawful acquisition of ownership.
The land specified in Article 1 above is hereby deleted from the state property inventory of the Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries.
Any provisions contrary to this sub-decree shall be considered null and void.

The Minister in charge of the Office of the Council of Ministers, the Minister of Economy and Finance, the Minister of Land Management, Urban Planning and Construction, the Minister of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries, the ministers of all ministries and the heads of all relevant institutions, and the Governor of the Ratanakiri Provincial Council shall be responsible for implementing this sub-decree in accordance with their respective duties from the date of signature onwards.
